title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Engagement: Card-Activity Relief on Pocketwire Rewards Clawbacks
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members who use their Pocketwire Visa Debit Card often receive a card-activity relief on points clawed back after a merchant refund.

## Rule

The clawback card-activity relief is 400 points when the member's debit cards carry at least 15 settled purchases dated within the last three months, 150 points when they carry at least 8 but fewer than 15, and nothing when they carry fewer than 8.

The relief is taken off the clawback for the refund, and a clawback is never reduced below zero; on tiers where the clawback is cut to the points balance, the cut applies to the clawback after the relief has been taken off.

The purchases counted are the settled purchase entries on the ledgers of all of the member's Pocketwire Visa Debit Cards. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Relief by purchase count

| Settled card purchases within the last three months | Relief |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | 400 points |
| 8 to 14 | 150 points |
| 7 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundary cases

- 15 settled purchases: 400 points; 14: 150 points.
- 8 settled purchases: 150 points; 7: nothing.
- Handled on 20 May 2025, a purchase dated 21 February 2025 is within the last three months; one dated 20 February 2025 is not.
